title: What's new in v2.11.1
summary: Live Traffic: see what is using your internet right now, by client, app, and destination, with every DNS lookup beside it.

steps.title: Live Traffic
steps.listLabel: See what is using your internet right now, flow by flow, with every DNS lookup
steps.body:
Every flow through your Gateway, ranked by what is using the link now. **Where It Goes** follows each client to its apps and out its WAN or VPN; click any of them to filter the page to it. **Live DNS** shows lookups as they happen, blocked ones and bypass to outside resolvers included, and **Flows** opens any connection to its two-minute chart and the Firewall Policy that allowed it.

Live Traffic runs on the On-Site Agent on your Gateway.

steps.title: Custom Apps
steps.listLabel: Name the traffic UniFi Network's DPI only knows by its port
steps.body:
Traffic that UniFi Network's DPI does not recognize shows as a bare port, like UDP 21324, drawn dotted. Hover it and **Name This App** fills in a Custom App from that flow: protocol, ports, and optionally where it goes or a remote domain or address.

Your name shows everywhere Live Traffic does, History and the Dashboard card included.

steps.title: Flow History
steps.listLabel: The last hour of flows from UniFi Network's own records, no agent needed
steps.body: **History** reads UniFi Network's own flow records, which reach back under an hour, and needs no agent. The **Timeline** stacks allowed and blocked flows per minute: drag across it or click it to pick a window.

steps.title: Live Traffic on the Dashboard
steps.listLabel: Bandwidth Hogs is now Live Traffic: your WAN by client, app, destination, or route
steps.body: The Bandwidth Hogs card is now **Live Traffic**. With the On-Site Agent on your Gateway, **By** groups your WAN traffic by Client, App, Destination, or Route, and a client's row opens to its flows. **Detailed View** opens the whole page.

steps.title: Live Traffic per Client
steps.listLabel: See one client's flows, apps, and DNS lookups as they happen
steps.body:
The **Data** tab is now **Data / Apps**. **Live Traffic** ranks the client's own flows by rate, **Applications** opens with the apps it is using right now, and **Live DNS** lists its lookups. On **Speed**, a line under **Live Throughput** says what the client is moving through the Gateway right now, with its busiest apps.

Without the On-Site Agent on your Gateway, Live Traffic shows the client's History from UniFi Network.
